scoring: All payout vectors and later blind levels are hypothetical sensitivity scenarios, not official information.
selection: Use tuning/validation only to choose a stable policy. Freeze source+asset hashes before final seeds. Final results are descriptive; local baselines do not establish contest-optimal play.
uncertainty: Report independent-seed-block mean and normal 95% confidence interval. Paired same-seed control comparisons reduce some deal variance but trajectories can diverge. Never treat actions as independent tournament samples.
latency: Measure both unfiltered act() wall time and CPU time; count >1ms, errors, illegal actions, internal budget fallbacks. Separate constructor/import cost. Include actual timeout enforcement in final tournament scenarios.
final_integration_note: After first evaluation, simulator table IDs were made independent of deck seeds. Agent policy and model unchanged. Fresh tournament seeds are used for the final rerun.
